scholarships.description: $20,000 USD GPA of 3.00 – 3.19 or a MCAT score of 488 – 492. Chancellor Scholarship $50,000 USD GPA of 3.20 – 3.39 or a MCAT score of 493 – 499.

scholarships.name: Dean’s Scholarship
scholarships.description: $75,000 USD GPA of 3.40 – 3.49 or a MCAT score of 500 – 504.

scholarships.name: President’s Scholarship
scholarships.description: $85,000 USD GPA of 3.50 – 3.69 or a MCAT score of 505 – 509.

scholarships.name: Future Physician Scholarship
scholarships.description: $100,000 USD GPA of 3.70+ or a MCAT score of 510+.
